name: list_tickets
description:
List tickets, optionally filtered by ``status``
        (``new``, ``open``, ``pending``, ``hold``, ``solved``, ``closed``).

        ``sort_by``/``sort_order`` accept the REST list's sort columns (``id``,
        ``subject``, ``created_at``, ``updated_at``, ``status``, ``requester``,
        ``assignee``, ``group``) and order the page identically, with ``id``
        breaking ties. ``limit`` (1-100, default 100) and ``offset`` page the
        result exactly as the REST ``per_page``/``page`` parameters do, so an
        agent can walk a large instance instead of pulling every ticket into its
        context.

status.title: Status
status.description: Ticket status: closed, hold, new, open, pending, solved.

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Column to sort by: assignee, assignee.name, created_at, deleted_at, group, id, requester, requester.name, status, subject, updated_at.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Records to skip before the page starts; 0 is the first page. Not a page number.

name: count_tickets
description: Total number of tickets (optionally for one ``status``) without listing them.

status.title: Status
status.description: Ticket status: closed, hold, new, open, pending, solved.

Fetch a single ticket by its numeric Zendesk id.

name: get_ticket_comments
description:
Fetch the comment thread for a ticket by its numeric Zendesk id.

        ``limit``/``offset`` page the thread as the REST comments list does; a
        long-running ticket's thread is not returned whole. ``sort_order``
        (``asc``/``desc``) orders by creation date, newest first with ``desc`` —
        how an agent reads the latest reply without paging the whole history.
        ``None`` when there is no such ticket, where REST 404s.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Records to skip before the page starts; 0 is the first page. Not a page number.

        resolves the requester of a ticket it only knows an email for.
